description: Retrieve an EXISTING public Evolize accessibility assessment for a website. Read-only: this starts no scan and creates no work. Returns not_found when no public report exists for the target — which says nothing about whether the site has accessibility problems. Evolize inspects publicly reachable pages of the target website in a real browser and runs deterministic accessibility checks (axe-core plus Evolize rules). It is not a local browser agent and it does not read your source code: findings reference the rendered DOM, so your coding agent maps them to source using its own repository access.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's `next_cursor`. Omit for the first page.

url.description: The public website to assess, e.g. `example.com` or `https://example.com`. Not an Evolize URL.

name: get_public_report
title: Get an existing public accessibility report
